entities.description: The reincarnation of Jugan, female guardian of Jukai Forest.

events.summary: During the Kami War, Jugan is summoned by the Fudaiju Monks and later the orochi; he dies and passes his strength to the monks.
events.quote: Eventually he died and passed his strength on to the monks.

events.summary: A wave of oni attacks culminates in the Night of Withering; the orochi resurrect Jugan, who with Ryusei defeats the oni.
events.quote: together Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion

events.summary: Jugan collects the essences of the other dragons, places them in an egg with Ryusei, and the egg is sealed in Boseiju.
events.quote: The egg was sealed into the heart of Boseiju

events.summary: After fifty years, Jugan is reborn as Kura, the Boundless Sky.
events.quote: His new form was that of Kura

relations.quote: Kura is the reincarnation of Jugan
together Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion
